body: I felt an inexplicable thrill as I reached out tentatively towards the tape-wrapped trunk, my fingers brushing against rough bark that seemed to pulse with life. Each twist and curve was like a secret whispered by nature itself. My curiosity piqued, I pulled back just enough to see the intricate patterns etched into the wood—symbols of ages past, telling stories untold.
